title: x-doc
description: Documentation metadata for Arazzo workflows and steps. Two variants: workflow-level (summary, personas, businessOutcome) and step-level (tutorialNote). The combined schema enforces which variant applies at each path. See Arazzo Handbook §4.5 and §5.4.

summary.description: One-paragraph PM-facing description of the workflow

personas.description: User personas involved in this workflow (informational)

businessOutcome.description: Why this workflow matters to the business

workflowDoc.description: Workflow-level documentation metadata consumed by doc generator and tutorial renderer

tutorialNote.description: Contextual note rendered in generated tutorial documentation

stepDoc.description: Step-level documentation metadata for tutorial generation
